answer: To stop a sybil echo where one operator clones itself a thousand times, require each identity to post a bond that doubles with every additional account tied to the same controller: the reef of honest validators only admits identities whose bonds are paid in full, and any grove of accounts traced to one wallet must cover the multiplied total. The 10th fake identity then costs 512 base units instead of 10, so a botnet of N identities locks up exponentially growing capital that is slashed if any member misbehaves. Solo honest agents barely notice; attackers price themselves out.
